data.desc: Cue Biopharma (Nasdaq: CUE) is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company focused on advancing a portfolio of potentially transformative therapies aimed at delivering durable, potentially disease-modifying benefits across immunological disorders. Its lead asset, CUE-221, is a novel anti-IgE antibody with a dual mechanism of action, currently in Phase 2 development for allergic diseases. In addition, Cue developed the Immuno-STAT platform which selectively targets disease-specific T cells in vivo without broad immune modulation. Its lead autoimmune candidate, CUE-401, is currently the subject of a Phase 1 clinical trial and is designed to regulate inflammation and drive Treg-mediated tolerance.
